title: Rabbi Huna bar Yitzchak
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Pesikta Rabbati, piska “BaChodesh HaShevi’i,” section 3, where Rabbi Yehoshua son of Rabbi Nechemyah speaks in his name. He is likewise mentioned in Midrash Tehillim 20:9.[^1]

notes.text: Pesikta Rabbati 40 in the OYW digital text names Rabbi Yehoshua the priest, son of Rabbi Nechemyah, reporting in the name of Rabbi Huna bar R’ Yitzchak. Midrash Tehillim 20:5 names Rabbi Huna bar Rav Yitzchak. Hyman’s section 3 and 20:9 references are retained beside these differently divided digital passages.
